chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Hammad ibn Isa from Shu'ayb ibn Ya'qub from Abu Basir who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the mut'ah of women, and he said: 'It is permissible, and a single dirham or more suffices for it.'

key_terms.اَلدِّرْهَمُ: The dirham (a silver coin used as a unit of currency/dowry)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum dowry required for a valid Mut'ah marriage in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Reported through the chain of Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) explicitly confirms the permissibility of Mut'ah, emphasizing its validity even with a minimal dowry of a single dirham. This ruling highlights the flexibility of the temporary marriage contract in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing it from permanent marriage by requiring only a specified minimum value rather than a substantial or customary dowry.
